requiredInvariants: Reuse the existing canonical ContractVersion and signed-document immutability chain; do not create ContractV2 or another agreement authority.
ApprovedTemplate and ClauseLibrary are versioned, approved, effective-dated and immutable after publication. Draft legal text cannot be used to produce a signable contract.

DealConstitution is an immutable snapshot of agreed commercial facts and source revisions; it is derived only from server-authoritative accepted Deal terms, never caller-supplied legal/commercial state.
SpecificationVersion is immutable, references one DealConstitution and one approved template/clause set, and records a deterministic DocumentHash over the exact render inputs/bytes.

LLM output may assist explanation or drafting outside authority but cannot become an ApprovedTemplate, ClauseLibrary entry, DealConstitution, ContractVersion or SpecificationVersion without the explicit governed approval path.
Amendment never mutates a signed ContractVersion. A change creates a new constitution/specification/contract version and a supersession/amendment link preserving the complete prior chain.
Every publication/constitution/specification command revalidates current tenant, organization, membership and required authority before mutation and replay.
All supporting authority tables/functions live in a dedicated contract_engine schema with FORCE RLS/memberless command ownership; runtime roles cannot direct-DML legal authority.
Command state, immutable event, audit, outbox and receipt commit atomically with payload-bound idempotency and optimistic versioning.
No signature, EDO send, financial obligation, provider receipt or external legal finality is manufactured by this foundation.
Registration, Role Eligibility, W2 market/inventory/trust work, Federal Accounting lock #4321, package/lockfiles and production topology remain unchanged.
acceptance: Restricted PostgreSQL tests prove versioned ApprovedTemplate/ClauseLibrary publication, effective-date selection, DealConstitution and SpecificationVersion immutability.
Unsigned drafts cannot be selected for a signable specification; retired/superseded template versions cannot silently replace a pinned historical version.
Changed source Deal facts or clause/template versions create a new immutable constitution/specification version and preserve the prior DocumentHash.
Direct UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE and same-tenant/cross-tenant outsider access are denied; revoked authority fails before mutation and replay.
Exact replay returns the original receipt; changed payload under the same idempotency key conflicts.
Audit/outbox/hash/evidence failure rolls the entire command back.
No existing signed ContractVersion is modified and no public Prisma schema drift is introduced by the foundation.
Forward migration, restore, cryptographic freshness and exact-head CI/review pass before any implementation merge.
